signal: Power Factors was acquired by Vista Equity Partners after acquisitions of Greenbyte and 3megawatt, managing over 110 gigawatts of renewable assets

email.body1:
Uday, saw Power Factors was acquired by Vista Equity Partners after the Greenbyte and 3megawatt deals.

With multiple customer bases merging, buying signals usually pile up faster than ops can route them, and reps lose hours on research, writing, and CRM logging instead of selling. Our AI SDR turns signals into reviewed, personalized outreach with every email auto-logged: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new headcount.

I built a personalized signal play for Power Factors off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Uday, quick follow-up for Power Factors.

Post-acquisition, most RevOps leads I talk to know signal-to-action latency is the bottleneck, but it is hard to see exactly where the handoff leaks before a lead goes cold. Our built-in best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three specific things I would change, and how a signal play would close the latency gap for Power Factors.
email.body3:
Uday, last bit of proof for Power Factors.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Power Factors' reply rate likely compares to other energy software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Uday, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If tightening signal-to-action latency is not a priority while the Vista integration settles, no problem at all. Merging acquired customer bases is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Power Factors either way.
